build_game_and_user_metadata: run build_metadata.py with --db-path, --game-folder, and --out to generate game stats and user stats JSON files
compute_logit_ratings: compute logit ratings for users by training a softmax model on pairwise game outcome comparisons
make_game_stats_and_user_stats: make game stats and user stats from a SQLite database, SQL-to-JSON ID map, and set of game JSON IDs
string_to_none_or_int: convert a string that is either 'None' or an integer string into None or an int
review_compute_logit_ratings: review compute_logit_ratings to understand how it constructs pairwise datasets, splits train/val, and optimizes user scores with Adagrad
